Name: Vampire House (Busty Emily and Haley)
Author: wetfart
Description:
Extensive overhaul including new and updated sprites, dialogue, events, schedules and gift preferences. For the best experience, don't use with other mods that reference Emily or Haley (doing so probably won't break your game... but may cause inconsistencies with the changes introduced by this mod).

CONTENT ADVISORY: Contains partial nudity and some sexual themes, but nothing explicit.

Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1572]Vampire Haley[/url]﻿.

For an enhanced atmosphere, I highly recommend the excellent [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4266]Halloween Feelings[/url]﻿ mod which is featured in Turin's video. 

[b]Haley’s Feeding Schedule[/b]
[spoiler]Haley feeds on Emily on Mondays, Wednesdays, and the following days of the month: 5, 7, 11, 17, 23. As a result, Emily will have bite marks and be extra spacey and lethargic on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and 6, 8, 12, 18, 24 of each month.[/spoiler]

[b]Haley’s 2-Heart Event Condition[/b]
[spoiler]Join Haley at the Saloon between 7pm and 11pm after receiving an invitation in the mail. The invitation will arrive in the mail the morning after reaching 2 hearts with Haley.[/spoiler]

[b]Haley’s 4-Heart Event Condition[/b]
[spoiler]Enter town between 8pm and 1:40am after reaching 4 hearts with Haley. You must also have witnessed her 2-heart event for this event to trigger.[/spoiler]

[b]Haley’s 6-Heart Event Condition[/b]
[spoiler]Join Haley at the Bathhouse Pool at any time after receiving an invitation in the mail. The invitation will arrive in the mail the morning after reaching 6 hearts with Haley, but only after witnessing her earlier heart events.[/spoiler]

[b]Haley’s 8-Heart Event Condition[/b]
[spoiler]Enter the mountain area between 11am and 5pm after reaching 8 hearts with Haley. You must have witnessed her 6-heart event for this event to trigger.[/spoiler]

[b]Haley’s 10-Heart Event Condition[/b]
[spoiler]Enter the farm between 8pm and 1:40am after reaching 10 hearts with Haley. You must have witnessed her 8-heart event for this event to trigger.[/spoiler]

[b]Emily’s 2-Heart Event Condition[/b]
[spoiler]Enter the doctor’s office on a day when Emily is displaying bite marks (Tue/Thu/6/8/12/18/24). You must have 2 hearts with Emily for the event to trigger.[/spoiler]

[b]Emily’s 4-Heart Event Condition[/b]
[spoiler]Enter Emily’s house any time when Emily and Haley are both present. You must have 4 hearts with Emily for the event to trigger, and also have witnessed her 2-heart event.[/spoiler]

[b]Emily’s 6-Heart Event Condition[/b]
[spoiler]Enter the forest on a sunny day in any season except winter, between 10am and 4pm. You must have 6 hearts with Emily, and also have witnessed her 4-heart event.[/spoiler]

[b]Emily’s 8-Heart Event Condition[/b]
[spoiler]Enter Emily’s house at any time when Emily and Haley are both present. You must have 8 hearts with Emily for the event to trigger, and also have witnessed her 6-heart event.[/spoiler]

[b]Emily’s 10-Heart Event Condition[/b]
[spoiler]Join Emily in the secret woods between 8pm and 1:40am after receiving an invitation in the mail. The invitation will be sent the morning after reaching 10 hearts with Emily, but only once you’ve also witnessed her 8-heart event.[/spoiler]
